_meta.purpose: Agricultural drought v0 (docs/DROUGHT_AGRI_KO.md): SPEI parameters, season, reference period, stage thresholds and farmland classes. Nothing here is tuned to observed losses.

spei.distribution_note: GEV by L-moments (Hosking & Wallis 1997), recommended for SPEI by Stagge et al. 2015 (Int. J. Climatol. 35:4027); the log-logistic (Vicente-Serrano 2010) is undefined for negatively skewed samples (44% of May and 66% of September cells in 1991-2020). 'loglogistic' kept for comparison.

unevaluated_classes.rice: 미평가: 관개 논은 저수율 지표 필요 (docs/DROUGHT_AGRI_KO.md)
unevaluated_classes.greenhouse: 미평가: 시설(시설재배)은 강수 의존이 아니라 SPEI 대상이 아님 (면적만 보고)

check._note: Sub check method (user rule 2026-11-10): one main method chosen for the hazard's characteristics plus a mandatory check that is recorded in metadata only and warns on disagreement; never a parallel result.
